title: finding(plugin-map): `ObjectMap` renders a marker's `descriptionField` value as a React child, so a description bound to a lookup crashes the popup once the row arrives expanded ("Objects are not valid as a React child")
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named site and a reproduction (class a). Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it. The site is `packages/plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx`: the marker popup, and the mobile record sheet, which render the `descriptionField` value as a React child; also the map search box, which calls `description.toLowerCase()`.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from the `os-dev-report` of objectui#10370 (PR objectui#10454, comment `5825517651`). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact

`ListMapConfigSchema.descriptionField` (spec) names a field whose value `ObjectMap` shows under a marker. The renderer puts that value straight into JSX. When the field is a lookup and the row arrives with the relation EXPANDED (`{ id, name }`), React throws on marker click. A bare id renders as text.

## Reproduction (the dev's one-shot probe, relayed, ⛔ not re-run by the seat)

An uncommitted probe in `packages/plugin-map` rendered the real `ObjectMap` with host rows (`react-map-gl` mocked the way `ObjectMap.markerTitle.test.tsx` mocks it) and clicked the marker:
- description `{ id: 'a1', name: 'Acme' }` ⇒ the render threw `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {id, name})`;
- control, description `'a1'` ⇒ the popup text was `Harbour Depota1`.

## Reach (read from source, ⛔ not measured end to end)

- `ObjectMap`'s own object-provider fetch expands every declared relation (`buildExpandFields(objectSchema?.fields)`, with no column list), so a map on a lookup-typed `descriptionField` reaches the crash with no list involved.
- A `ListView` map with no authored columns expands every relation too, and so does a `ListView` whose columns include the lookup.
- The search box calls `description.toLowerCase()`. An object or number there would throw as well (read, not measured).
- PR objectui#10454 does NOT widen the reach: its `$expand` collector deliberately excludes `descriptionField`, pinned.

## Grading notes (for triage, not a grade)

- The shape of the fix is the renderer's: show a lookup the way other faces do (its display name, or its id), and make the search read a string. ⛔ No change to the spec key.
- Seam: `spec:ListMapConfigSchema.descriptionField` → `renderer:ObjectMap` (marker popup, mobile record sheet, search).

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items, pattern `ObjectMap | plugin-map | marker popup` near `descriptionField | React child` ⇒ only objectui#10454 (the source PR). Must-hit control `ObjectMap` ⇒ 27 hits.

Dedupe words: `ObjectMap descriptionField lookup React child` · `map marker description expanded object crash` · `Objects are not valid as a React child map popup` · `ObjectMap description toLowerCase`
